Video editing and processing: FFmpeg, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut. Generative AI fundamentals: LLMs for scripts and prompts; how diffusion and video models behave. Content formats: YouTube, Shorts and Instagram Reels: aspect ratios, hooks, pacing and retention. Visual storytelling: framing, basic cinematography, composition, colour and typography. DESIRABLE SKILLS (GOOD TO HAVE) ComfyUI workflows and custom nodes with open video models such as Wan or LTX. LoRA training for consistent characters, products and brand styles. Agent frameworks such as LangChain or CrewAI for multi-step content automation. Content provenance and labelling (C2PA, watermarking). Experience in a content, advertising, media or marketing team. Experience in a content, advertising, media or marketing team. Degree in Fine Arts, Animation, Digital Media, Film Studies, Computer Science or a related field; freshers with a strong portfolio are welcome.
